warnings: The source abstract and main text disagree on the denominator for the -6.14 AMISOS-R result; ATOM and SEA use Table 2/results (n=7) and separately preserve the n=8 LOCF analysis (-5.37).
The source prose says SCL-90 decreased 33%, but Table 2 means 172.83 to 154.83 imply approximately 10.4%; downstream artifacts preserve the table values and flag the discrepancy.
The source says no adverse events were reported but also describes treatment-emergent suicidal ideation, fatigue/headache, and symptom provocation; no stronger safety claim was inferred.
The AMISOS-R supplementary appendix mentioned by the article was not present in the audited packet.
The governing SEA file is named v4 but contains an internal Integrated Compact v3 heading; project precedence treats the v4-named file as authoritative.
